chapters.reason: Primary focus on distilling or compressing reasoning chains into more concise representations for System 1, i.e., reducing explicit CoT while preserving performance.
Discusses latent-space SFT, i.e., reasoning in hidden representations rather than explicit tokens, aligning with the paper's goal of avoiding explicit intermediate reasoning tokens.
Considers efficient test-time scaling and dynamic compute considerations, reflecting the paper's emphasis on reducing inference cost when deploying distilled System 1 outputs.
